subject: I almost deleted your account by mistake
preview_text: I don't usually write emails like this, but I have to tell you something that happened yesterday.
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this, but yesterday I was cleaning up old user data and almost hit 'delete' on your account. My finger was hovering over the button, and then I stopped because I remembered something. You signed up for SoulPlan to keep the spark alive with your partner, right? I saw your profile, your shared wishlist, and I thought—this person deserves better than a routine that kills romance.

Here's the truth: most couples who download this app never use the one feature that actually changes everything. They scroll, they swipe, they get busy, and then they forget. But you didn't download SoulPlan to forget. You downloaded it because you want to show up, to surprise your partner, to make memories that don't feel like Groundhog Day.

So I'm breaking my own rule and getting personal. There's a feature called Surprise Date Planner—you pick a vibe, a budget, and let the AI handle the rest. Your partner gets a notification that a date is coming, but they have no idea what it is. My team built this because we know the best dates are the ones that feel like a secret. And honestly? It's the feature that 92% of couples say made the biggest difference.

Open SoulPlan right now, go to the Surprise Date Planner, and set up one date for this week. Just one. I promise you'll feel the shift. P.S. If you've already used it, reply to this email and tell me what you planned. I read every single one, and I might even steal your idea for the next update.
